en.name: Shibuya Crossing and Hachiko
en.description: The world's busiest pedestrian intersection and iconic meeting landmark anchored by the beloved loyalty statue of Hachiko. Thousands cross simultaneously surrounded by giant digital screens and neon displays.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Paid public parking options available nearby.
